skillData.title: Core Frontend Expertise
skillData.text: As a dedicated Frontend Developer with over a year of professional experience, I specialize in crafting responsive, user-centric web applications that balance technical precision with creative design. My expertise lies in building seamless digital experiences using a modern tech stack, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React.js, alongside styling frameworks like Tailwind and Bootstrap. From my work at RYZE360 and DOT Pvt Ltd, I have a proven track record of transforming complex UI/UX mockups into functional, high-performance components while maintaining clean, scalable code. I am particularly focused on optimizing website performance and implementing SEO best practices to ensure every application I build is both efficient and accessible to a wide audience.

experience.title: RYZE360
experience.subTitle: Frontend Developer
experience.text: At RYZE360, I build responsive, user-friendly web interfaces and collaborate closely with designers and backend developers to deliver clean, accessible UI components. I follow best coding practices, participate in code reviews, and use Git with agile workflows to ensure timely delivery. I also focus on performance optimization and troubleshooting to create smooth, efficient user experiences.

experience.title: DOT PVT LTD
experience.subTitle: Frontend Developer Internship
experience.text: During my internship at DOT Pvt Ltd, I contributed to building responsive, cross-browser compatible websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I collaborated closely with UI/UX designers to transform mockups into functional and visually appealing  web pages. The experience allowed me to focus on writing clean, maintainable code while optimizing website performance,giving me hands-on exposure to real-world frontend development workflows and team collaboration.
